functions.name: batch-import-conversation-activities
functions.description: Upload a bounded transcript of past activities for a client to render in an existing conversation. The provider returns an aggregate resource reference, not per-activity outcomes.

conversationId.description: Existing conversation receiving the historical transcript.

id.description: Stable historical activity ID used by clients to recognize duplicate activities.

name.description: Original event or invocation name, when relevant.

text.description: Original Unicode text, including empty text when appropriate.

type.description: Historical activity kind; channel support varies.

value.description: Original structured event data, with dynamic event-specific properties.

sentAt.description: Original sent instant with explicit offset; preserve fractional-second precision without rounding when converting to UTC.

senderId.description: Original sender's channel account ID, not an instruction to send a new live message as that user.

textFormat.description: Original rendering format; omission uses the provider's default.

replyToActivityId.description: Historical source activity ID to which this item replied.

items.description: One historical activity with its original sender, stable ID, sent instant, and optional content.

activities.description: At most 50 historic activities in this one import; IDs must be unique within the submitted transcript and appropriate to the destination history.

FunctionInput_microsoft_teams_bot_batchi.description: An existing conversation and a bounded transcript of historical activities to import.

id.description: Aggregate resource ID returned for the transcript request; not a per-item receipt.

FunctionOutput_microsoft_teams_bot_batch.description: The aggregate transcript resource reference, without individual activity outcomes.

serviceUrl.description: Trusted serviceUrl saved from incoming bot context for the destination conversation.

FunctionMetadata_microsoft_teams_bot_bat.description: Saved Connector routing established by the application from trusted bot context.

tags.instructions: Use this to import historical activities, not to send new live messages. Obtain the conversation ID from bot context or `create-conversation`. Supply at most 50 historic activities with unique IDs and their actual sent times. Client duplicate handling is not an atomic import or safe-replay guarantee. Unsupported channels can reject history upload.

functions.name: delete-activity
functions.description: Remove an existing activity, including a message, from its conversation where the channel permits deletion. No restore operation is available through this integration.

activityId.description: Activity to remove; opaque and scoped to its conversation.

FunctionInput_microsoft_teams_bot_delete.description: Identifies the conversation and existing activity to delete.

deleted.description: The provider reported successful deletion; not an assertion about retention copies.

activityId.description: Activity identified by the successful deletion request.

conversationId.description: Conversation from which deletion was requested.

FunctionOutput_microsoft_teams_bot_delet.description: Acknowledgment of successful deletion of the identified activity.

tags.instructions: Obtain conversation and activity IDs from incoming bot context or a send result. This removes the activity, not the conversation or its members. Recovery and retention are channel-dependent; do not assume it can be restored. Use `update-activity` to replace content instead.

functions.name: list-conversation-members
functions.description: List one page of a conversation's user and bot accounts. A compatibility mode uses the channel's unpaginated membership endpoint.

mode.description: Paged browsing by default; unpaged returns the one complete response of the compatibility endpoint.

limit.description: Suggested paged response size, default 100; the channel may return a different count. Not available in unpaged mode.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same conversation in paged mode; omit to start.

FunctionInput_microsoft_teams_bot_listco.description: Conversation membership browsing options for one paged or unpaged response.

id.description: Opaque user or bot channel account ID.

name.description: Display name when supplied, retaining empty strings.

role.description: Account role such as user or bot when supplied.

aadObjectId.description: Microsoft Entra account object ID when supplied; not the channel ID.

items.description: A user or bot channel account in this conversation.
Accounts in this provider response; possibly empty and not guaranteed unique across pages.

nextCursor.description: Continuation for this conversation's paged results; omitted when exhausted or in unpaged mode.

FunctionOutput_microsoft_teams_bot_listc.description: One membership response and, when available, its bound continuation cursor.

serviceUrl.description: Trusted service URL saved from incoming bot context; omit to use the configured Teams service URL.

tags.instructions: Obtain the conversation ID from incoming context or `create-conversation`. By default this returns one provider page; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` with the same conversation and mode to continue. Members can repeat across pages. limit is a suggestion, not an exact count. Use mode=unpaged only for a known small conversation or a channel without paged support; use `get-conversation-member` for a known member.

functions.name: list-signing-keys

e.description: RSA exponent in its original JWK base64url form.

alg.description: Standard signing algorithm identifier when present.

Public JSON Web Keys from the discovered key-set document, retaining standard cryptographic representation.

FunctionOutput_microsoft_teams_bot_lists.description: The complete advertised public signing key set for the selected authority.

tags.instructions: Use for authentication implementation or diagnostics. Select the same authority as your validation path. This discovers the current key URL automatically and returns one complete key set, not a page. It does not verify a JWT; validation must also check issuer, audience, validity and any required channel endorsements.
